metadata.title: Increase in topological complexity along the mean curvature flow
metadata.abstract: We construct an example of a smooth embedding of $\mathbb{S}^{p+q-1}$ in $\mathbb{R}^{p+q}$ whose evolution under the mean curvature flow forms an isolated singularity at one point, after which it is a smoothly embedded copy of $\mathbb{S}^{p-1}\times \mathbb{S}^q$. In doing so, we prove some general results about $SO(p)\times SO(q)$-invariant mean curvature flow whose initial data is generated by the rotation of a graphical profile curve, including an analysis of bubblesheet singularities. The most involved part of our analysis is an instant smoothness result, which requires a delicate approximation and pseudolocality.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 平均曲率流越过奇点后的拓扑复杂度增加
analysis.workSummary: 构造嵌入球面 S^(p+q−1) 的平均曲率流，在孤立点奇异后成为 S^(p−1)×S^q；发展 SO(p)×SO(q) 对称流、bubblesheet 与瞬时光滑性。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供奇异后拓扑复杂度增加的具体例子。
analysis.limitations: 结论采用文中跨奇点的演化方式和维数条件，不是所有弱平均曲率流都具有相同拓扑转变。
